    from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter

    mask = np.zeros_like(image)
    mask[lower:, :left] = 1

    blurred_image = gaussian_filter(image, sigma=5) * mask + image * (1 - mask)

    women_in_dress = [w for w in women_patches if abs((w.left + w.right) / 2 - closest_women_to_dress) < 10]
    sliver_in_dress = [s for s in sliver_patches if abs((s.left + s.right) / 2 - closest_sliver_to_dress) < 10]

    if women_in_dress and sliver_in_dress:
        return women_in_dress[0]
    elif women_in_dress:
        return women_in_dress[0]
    elif sliver_in_dress:
